decision: We will cap public-capture custom_fields at 20 keys and 8 KiB of JSON (422 above), numbers chosen by us since the brief named no values.
We will add a per-org capture limit of 120/minute and 1500/hour on top of the per-IP 20/minute;200/hour, values chosen by us.
We will fail the orbity WhatsApp webhook closed (401) in any deploy context, via the seed is_deploy_context, when WAHA_WEBHOOK_HMAC_SECRET is unset; the router had no such check.
We will lock only the 10 orbity tables reached solely by the service role; the 26 tables read by user-JWT routers under RLS need a service-role refactor first, for the owner to rule on.
We will go live after the round-3 items; per the owner's live ruling of 2026-11-10 the 9-router service-role refactor is the NEXT slice, not this one.
options_considered: Owner (live session, 2026-11-10) ruled: go live after the 6 round-3 items; refactor next slice.

decision: We will add the public access-tier category token-link, with resolve_token_link and a keeper rule, as the owner ruled in the live session of 2026-11-10.
options_considered: Owner (live session, 2026-11-10) ruled: create the token-link category with mandatory protections (high-entropy token, fail-closed expiry, one-time use on mutation, rate limit, no token in logs, no internal ids).

decision: We will default report links to 30 days (backfilling published ones), gate capture with the license check (404/503), and accept unsigned webhooks only for APP_ENV local/dev/development/test/testing.
options_considered: Values chosen by us (30 days; license check reuses enforce_license; local set from the seed); the notify cap is spent, so this goes to the tech-lead as an escalate row.
